The '''Alangan language''' is a language spoken by [[Mangyan]]s in the [[provinces of the Philippines|province]] of [[Mindoro]] in the [[Philippines]].

Alangan is spoken by 2,150 people in the following municipalities of north-central Mindoro (''Ethnologue'').
*[[Sablayan]] municipality, [[Mindoro Occidental Province]]
*[[Naujan]] municipality, [[Mindoro Oriental Province]]
*[[Victoria, Oriental Mindoro|Victoria]] municipality, [[Mindoro Oriental Province]]

The Ayan Bekeg dialect spoken on the northeast slopes of Mount Halcon is understood by Alangan speakers throughout the area (Tweddell 1970:193).<ref name="Tweddell1970">Tweddell, Colin E. 1970. "[https://www.jstor.org/stable/30029250 The Identity and Distribution of the Mangyan Tribes of Mindoro, Philippines]". ''Anthropological Linguistics'' 12 (6).</ref>

Barbian (1977)<ref name="Barbian1977">Barbian, Karl-Josef. 1977. English-Mangyan vocabulary. Cebu City: University of San Carlos.</ref> lists the following locations.
*Casague, [[Santa Cruz, Occidental Mindoro]]
*Kulasisi (tributary of the Mompong River), near Barrio Arellano, [[Sablayan, Occidental Mindoro]]
